# Security Policy

## Supported Versions

| Version | Supported          |
| ------- | ------------------ |
| 1.x     | :white_check_mark: |

## Reporting a Vulnerability

We take the security of SiteBackupBundle seriously. If you believe you have found a security vulnerability, please report it privately:

- Email: hectorfranco@nowo.tech
- Or use GitHub private vulnerability reporting on this repository

Please do not disclose security issues publicly until we have had a chance to address them.
